title: Network Scheme Compliance Simulator (Visa VAMP / Mastercard DIMP)
description: Deterministic Visa VAMP and Mastercard DIMP/VIMP threshold simulation engine. Separate acquirer vs. merchant thresholds with phased enforcement timelines (Oct 2025, Jan 2026 acquirer bands, Apr 2026 merchant tightening). VAAI enumeration rate as a third independent compliance dimension. Computes VAMP ratio, RAG status, headroom, enforcement fee exposure, what-if scenarios, and deterministic remediation action plan. AP2 JSON scheme_compliance_mandate export. Client-side. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: simulate_scheme_compliance_thresholds
mcp_tool_definition.description: Simulate Visa VAMP and Mastercard DIMP/VIMP threshold positions using phased enforcement timelines. Three independent compliance dimensions: VAMP ratio (TC40+TC15-excluded)/settled_CNP, VAAI enumeration rate (effective June 2025, triggers independently), and Mastercard DIMP/VIMP ratios. Acquirer bands (EW 0.4%/AS 0.5%/Excessive 0.7%) effective January 2026; merchant phase 2 tightening (2.2%→1.5%) from April 2026 for US/Canada/EU/APAC. Computes headroom to each threshold, enforcement fee exposure after grace period, and deterministic remediation controls. Use when a card programme manager or fraud team needs to assess scheme compliance threshold position.
